articles.title: A SpaceX Rocket Just Slammed Into the Moon — and Scientists Are Racing to See the Damage
articles.summary: A SpaceX Falcon 9 upper stage crashed into the moon at 5,400 mph this morning, creating a crater up to 89 feet wide. Now, lunar orbiters are trying to photograph the impact site to learn more about the moon.

articles.title: From 'Public Enemy' to Cultural Icon: The Incredible Comeback of Yellowstone's Wolves
articles.summary: Wolves were wiped out from Yellowstone by 1926, but a historic reintroduction in 1995 brought them back. Now the park is the best place in the US to see them. Here's the story of their dramatic return.

articles.title: A Colossal Magma System Is Hiding Beneath Tuscany — and It's as Big as Yellowstone's
articles.summary: Scientists discovered a massive magma system under Tuscany, Italy, with a volume of 6,000 cubic kilometers — comparable to Yellowstone's. It was found using seismic imaging and could help locate geothermal energy and critical minerals.
